summary.en: A React + Firebase pairing layer that lets every phone in the room join an app in one scan.
summary.jp: React と Firebase による接続用ライブラリ。会場のスマホ全部を、一回のスキャンでアプリに参加させる。

mine: Extracted the pairing logic first built for Marubatsu Arena into a standalone React + Firebase library
Built QR/6-character-code pairing, presence heartbeat, room capacity, and security rules
Packaged a Claude Code skill so an agent can add multi-device play to any app
